jobsmenu.aviso.0: The company does not cover disappearances outside working hours.
jobsmenu.aviso.1: Please do not describe what you saw. Not to the foreman, not to each other.
jobsmenu.aviso.2: Stock lost during a sighting is deducted all the same.
jobsmenu.aviso.3: Shifts of a worker who does not clock out are reassigned after 48 hours.
jobsmenu.aviso.4: Running is not forbidden. It is not advised either.
jobsmenu.aviso.5: Sighting times are approximate. Everything here is approximate.
jobsmenu.aviso.6: If the corridor goes quiet, it was not the lamp.
jobsmenu.aviso.7: Thank you for your commitment. There are few of you left.
